summary: Phase FLAGADMIN.1 — Flagship CRUD + Pre-roll Parity fully verified. 17/17 backend pytest cases passed (validate-stream good+bad, admin-only, CRUD with slug collision, warn-only bad URL, independent field updates, preroll toggle off→disabled→on→re-enabled, seeded flagship parity, soft-delete hides row, hard-delete + 404 on retry, audit log has 4 entries in reverse chrono). Frontend Playwright covers page load (13 flagships / 13 preroll toggles), Add modal with stream probe, Edit modal, Delete modal (hard-delete with exact-name confirmation gate) and preroll toggle. Success rate: backend 100%, frontend ~95% (2 minor cosmetic misses noted).

ui_bugs.issue: The in-component 'Admin access required' fallback ([data-testid=admin-flagship-forbidden]) never renders — ProtectedRoute in App.js redirects non-admins to '/' before this component mounts. RBAC is still enforced (verified: demo user redirected home), but the review-request's assertion 'non-admin user sees the Admin access required fallback' does not match runtime behavior. Consider either (a) documenting the redirect behavior or (b) letting the component-level fallback render (drop admin gating in ProtectedRoute for this specific route).

integration_issues.flow: Edit → success toast detection in test
integration_issues.issue: Toast is dismissed after 4.5s (setTimeout in showToast). This is expected UX but caused my test to sometimes fail to observe the toast if timing is off. Not a bug — noted for future test scripting. Underlying PATCH succeeded (backend audit trail confirms).

The inline preroll toggle switch does not expose aria-checked attribute (returned None in test). Toggle still works (backend row updates preroll_enabled correctly, verified via backend PATCH tests). For a11y + testability, consider adding role='switch' + aria-checked='true|false' to [data-testid^='admin-flagship-preroll-toggle-'].

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Reconcile RBAC layers — either drop admin-only guard from ProtectedRoute for /admin/flagship-stations so the in-component 'Admin access required' fallback shows, OR remove the dead-code fallback and rely on ProtectedRoute redirect.
OPTIONAL/LOW: Add role='switch' + aria-checked to admin-flagship-preroll-toggle-{slug} for accessibility + easier automated verification.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminFlagshipStations.jsx is 767 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting FlagshipFormModal, FlagshipDeleteModal, PrerollToggle, UploadLogoButton to separate files under /pages/admin/flagship/.

In flagship_stations.py admin_delete_flagship soft-delete branch, the code overwrites 'flagship_by' with the deleting admin's id (line 608). This clobbers the original creator attribution. Consider using a separate 'soft_deleted_by' field.

_validate_stream_url uses subprocess.run to curl — introduces process-fork overhead and requires curl binary at runtime. Consider httpx.AsyncClient with Range header for a fully async, in-process probe.
audit trail dedupes on _id but not on same-second identical actions. Not a correctness issue but note for future analytics.
